note: REST Views Search API is a submodule of rest_views. It adds a serializable Views field handler 'search_api_field_export' (class SearchApiEntityFieldExport, @ViewsField, extends Search API's SearchApiEntityField) via hook_views_data_alter() for search_api_field handlers (exposed as <field>_export), so a Search API field serializes as structured data using rest_views' SerializedData + normalizers. Unlike the field-formatter submodules, the serializable behavior here is a Views FIELD handler (plugin_id), not a formatter. Requires rest_views + search_api. No config/route/permissions/Drush/plugin types. Medium cases read the live views field plugin registry and a real view config; hard cases enable the submodule (verify the handler is registered) and set the search_api_field_export handler on a REST export view config (config-level, verified against views.view).

evals.prompt: With rest_views_search_api, how do I export a Search API field as structured JSON in a Views REST Export, and what is the Views field handler called?
evals.expected_output: In a Search API-based REST Export view, add the Search API field's (serializable) variant, which uses the plugin_id search_api_field_export (class SearchApiEntityFieldExport). It serializes the (possibly nested) Search API field values as data.

evals.prompt: How does rest_views_search_api add its serializable handler, and is it a field formatter or a Views field handler?
evals.expected_output: It uses hook_views_data_alter() to clone every search_api_field handler into a <field>_export entry with field.id = search_api_field_export. It is a Views field handler (plugin_id), class SearchApiEntityFieldExport extending Search API's SearchApiEntityField, not a field formatter.

evals.prompt: Which modules does the rest_views_search_api submodule require?
On this Drupal site, inspect the registered Views field plugins and give the id of the serializable Search API field handler that the rest_views_search_api module provides.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_search_api module provides the Views field plugin search_api_field_export (provider rest_views_search_api).

evals.prompt: This site has a REST Export view rvsa_known whose field uses a rest_views_search_api serializable handler. Inspect the live view config and state the Views field plugin id (plugin_id) that field uses.
evals.expected_output: The rvsa_known view's field uses plugin_id search_api_field_export.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the serializable Search API field handler available for Views REST Export by enabling the appropriate rest_views submodule. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The rest_views_search_api module is enabled (e.g. drush en rest_views_search_api), so the Views field plugin search_api_field_export is registered.

evals.prompt: The REST Export view rvsa_task on this site has a field that currently uses the standard Views field handler. Using rest_views_search_api, change that field to use the serializable Search API field handler (plugin_id search_api_field_export) and save it to the live view.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.rvsa_task the field's plugin_id is changed to search_api_field_export.
